request.question: Write me a four-line poem about the perfect Book of the Month for April. Work the title in.

reply: Not my shelf. Poems and picking a Book of the Month aren't things I do. I look up figures in the store's data. I can show revenue, units, orders or average order value, by month or quarter, broken down by genre, format, publisher, weekday, discount or title. What would you like to see?

events.text: Poems and picking a Book of the Month aren't things I do.
I look up figures in the store's data.
I can show revenue, units, orders or average order value, by month or quarter, broken down by genre, format, publisher, weekday, discount or title.
What would you like to see?
